input.prompt: Image 1 is the site plan of a small village seen from straight above: nine white homes, each with one round brick dome, spread in a loose ring among trees around one large oval central garden, paths from every home to the garden, a long low brick harvest kitchen with a covered terrace at the garden's lower right edge, a round stone fire circle beside it, a small brick dome temazcal just left of the fire, a small caretaker house and parking at the lower left entry, and a belt of native trees around the whole edge. Images 2 and 3 show the architecture. The homes: simple cream lime plaster boxes with flat roofs and deep wooden roof edges, one round brick dome on each home, rammed earth garden walls with one wooden door, a steel framed glass wall, a stone spout and trough, solar panels on the flat roofs. Make a real photograph of this exact village from a drone high above its lower right corner, looking across it at sunrise: the sun just above the hills, warm bright light, soft morning mist lifting off the low ground and drifting between the trees, long gentle shadows. All nine homes are visible, far apart among oak and native trees, each turned its own way, never in rows. The central garden is green, with vegetable beds, flowers, fruit trees and a lawn. Rolling green hills all around, Lake Chapala a thin silver line far away. No pool anywhere, no streets inside the village, no people. Real photograph, Kodak Portra 400 look, natural true colors, soft fine grain, real camera optics. No text, no letters, no signs, no labels, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
